{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load and clean data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Remove refunded orders
df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Ensure only converted orders are used in revenue per converted order
df_converted = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Calculate average revenue per converted order by channel and segment
df_grouped = df_converted.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'], as_index=False)['revenue'].mean()

# Pivot to compare channels
df_pivot = df_grouped.pivot(index='customer_segment', columns='channel', values='revenue')

df_pivot = df_pivot.rename(columns={'email': 'email_avg', 'paid_search': 'paid_search_avg'})

df_pivot['difference'] = df_pivot['email_avg'] - df_pivot['paid_search_avg']

df_pivot = df_pivot.round(2)

df_pivot"}
